explication: Embabel is a JVM framework for building typed agentic flows that combine code, domain objects and LLM interactions. An application defines actions and goals through annotations or a Kotlin DSL; the platform plans and replans actions against the current state, then returns the achieved result. The tree also shows model-provider, RAG and A2A server capabilities. The execution relationships below follow README concepts and the sampled implementations; some subsystem links are omitted because their callers were not sampled.
